output.summary: A woody-stemmed flowering plant native to the Iberian Peninsula, it grows mainly on inland, sandy acidic soils in uncultivated ground, slopes and rainfed crops. Its upright stems branch strongly from the base and bear rigid, angular branches. The plant is reported as toxic to humans and ruminants.
output.edibilityNote: Reported toxic to humans; the source does not specify a plant part or preparation.
